Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the sale, purchase, or use of alcohol vaporizing devices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulating alcohol vaporizing devices;reenacting and amending RCW 66.04.010; adding a new section to chapter66.44 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person may not sell, offer for sale, purchase, use, or offerfor use an alcohol vaporizing device. (2) In addition to any other penalties that may apply by rule, aviolation of this section is punishable under RCW 66.44.180. (3) This section does not apply to vaporizing devices used formedical or scientific research purposes.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 66.04.010 and 2006 c 225 s 1 and 2006 c 101 s 1 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

(2) "Alcohol vaporizing device" means any mechanical or electricalapparatus that mixes liquor or other alcohol product with oxygen orother gas to produce a vapor or mist for the purpose of inhaling.
